newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar to sell Eletrobras shrs Monday.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar to sell Eletrobras shrs Monday.

text.p: BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment wing of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), said it would sell Monday 149.5 million of Eletrobras common shares in the forward market.

The shares, which account for 0.33 percent of Eletrobras' voting capital and 0.28 percent of the firm's total capital, will settle on October 10, 1997, but investors will be allowed to liquidate their contracts before the settlement date, it said in a statement.

The shares' minimum price will be 108 percent of the stock's base price, which will be equivalent to Eletrobras' average price in the spot market between 1030 local/1330 GMT and 1330/1630 GMT on the Rio de Janeiro bourse at the auction's date, it added.
Merrill Lynch and Co and Banco Omega are coordinating the sale, the statement said.
